title: AMVMakerSchemas
description: Shared JSON schemas for AMV Maker pipeline communication between Python engine and UI/TypeScript

id.description: Unique identifier for the audio cue note

timestamp_ms.description: Millisecond-accurate timestamp on the audio track

tags.description: Manual director tags for this audio moment

note.description: Freeform creative instruction for the AI Director at this timestamp

label.description: Musical segment descriptor (e.g. intro, verse_1, chorus_1)

audio_mood.description: Classified segment audio mood (e.g. vocal_intimate, vocal_soaring, instrumental_calm, rhythmic_groove, high_energy_drop, dramatic_build)

duration_sec.description: Total duration of audio in seconds

tempo_bpm.description: Detected tempo in beats per minute

downbeats.description: Timestamps of measure downbeats (Bar starts) in seconds

beats.description: Timestamps of all detected beats in seconds

energy_segments.description: Calculated energy segments across the track

audio_notes.description: User-authored millisecond-level cue tags and director notes on the soundtrack

source_file.description: Absolute path to source video or image file

duration.description: Duration in seconds (0.0 for static images)

is_still_image.description: True if source is a static artwork or photo

keyframe_path.description: Relative/absolute path to thumbnail keyframe image

sharpness_score.description: Laplacian variance measure of frame sharpness

dramatism_score.description: Visual dramatism intensity combining contrast, range, and motion (0-100)

color_mood.description: Color palette mood (warm_golden, cool_cinematic, vibrant_festive, moody_dark, neutral_balanced)

visual_mood.description: Overall visual mood (joyful_bright, energetic_action, dramatic_intense, serene_scenic, melancholic_muted, warm_intimate)

has_faces.description: True if one or more faces detected

face_count.description: Number of faces detected in keyframe

dominant_expression.description: Detected facial expression (laughing / ecstatic, joyful / smiling, surprised / amazed, angry / intense, sad / melancholic, worried / tense, focused / determined, calm / neutral)

emotion_scores.description: Blendshape emotion confidence map (joy, surprise, anger, sadness, worry, neutral)

user_tags.description: Manual user tags for AI Director guidance

user_note.description: Manual user creative note for this clip or image

source_files.description: List of source video/image files analyzed

scenes.description: Detected visual scene intervals and metrics

source_file.description: Path to source video or image file

source_in.description: Source clip in-point timestamp in seconds

source_out.description: Source clip out-point timestamp in seconds

timeline_start.description: Placement start time on AMV timeline in seconds

timeline_end.description: Placement end time on AMV timeline in seconds

keyframe_path.description: Optional thumbnail path for timeline UI preview

track_index.description: Video track index (0 = V1, 1 = V2, etc.)

user_tags.description: Manual user tags on this timeline cut

user_note.description: Manual user note on this timeline cut

cuts.description: Ordered sequence of cuts placed against the audio timeline
